rounds.title: Game Show Style
rounds.instructions: Varies weekly: True/False, Name That Tune, Multiple Choice, or Family Feud.

questions.clue: Which ancient civilization is credited with the first known writing system, cuneiform?
questions.explanation: The Sumerians, an ancient civilization in Mesopotamia, developed cuneiform, one of the earliest writing systems, around 3200 BCE.

questions.clue: Which scientist is known for the uncertainty principle in quantum mechanics?
questions.explanation: Werner Heisenberg formulated the uncertainty principle, which states that certain pairs of physical properties cannot both be known to arbitrary precision.

questions.clue: In which film did the phrase 'Here's looking at you, kid' become iconic?
questions.explanation: The phrase 'Here's looking at you, kid' was famously spoken by Humphrey Bogart in the classic film 'Casablanca' (1942).
